findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: flat_auth · Private data: flat_pay, flat_register, flat_auth, flat_verify · Public sink: flat_earn, flat_register, flat_verify, flat_suggest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: flat_auth · Private data: flat_pay, flat_register, flat_auth, flat_verify · Public sink: flat_earn, flat_register, flat_verify, flat_suggest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "flat_read" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
